_source: https://store.ef.com/pages/returns-faq (scraped 2026-11-05). Delivery times and costs are not published there; see DATA_GAPS.md.
shipping: Made to order: printed for you after you order, so it isn’t sitting in a warehouse.
You can edit or cancel for a short time after ordering, until it goes to production.
International orders may owe import duties. Checkout shows either a pre-collected duty amount or a notice.
returns_extra: You have 30 days after delivery to report a quality issue. Send a photo of the problem with your order number.
